tagline: Independent coverage of the identity and access world

hero.title: Engineer ends decade-old 'every workflow fires at once' problem in identity platform overhaul
hero.snippet: A single mis-routed change event used to trigger every application workflow on the platform at once. One engineer's fix: make the platform ask which one actually changed before it does anything.

stories.title: Two-team, two-week access request now takes minutes, firm confirms
stories.snippet: A manual process spanning two departments has been replaced by a single self-service workflow, saving an estimated 350 hours of admin a year.

stories.title: Financial firm closes toxic access loophole after two-year governance programme
stories.snippet: A segregation of duties programme built with a Big Four advisory firm now blocks the riskiest combinations outright, while allowing lower-risk exceptions to proceed with sign-off.

stories.title: In-house reporting tool quietly replaces creaking PowerShell scripts
stories.snippet: A rule library now handles report generation and delivery that used to run outside the platform entirely, closing a gap nobody had got round to fixing.

stories.title: 100 credentials, 3 safes: the vault clean-up nobody noticed
stories.snippet: A quiet piece of credential segregation work has reduced non-production exposure to production secrets across a major platform, without a single outage.

stories.title: Small team, big roadmap: inside a two-person identity function
stories.snippet: Presented to over 150 colleagues at a company-wide technology event, the function now owns a standing roadmap covering governance, security and automation, built with a team you could fit at one desk.

stories.title: Direct connector chosen over 'quicker' SCIM route, and the reasoning holds up
stories.snippet: An engineer's case for full lifecycle control over a faster integration option is being cited elsewhere as the sensible default, not the cautious one.
